name: The Magical City of Dalaran
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, one of our mages will be waiting to receive you upon your arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon you when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
narrative.objectives: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 2,555 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: Exploring the Alliance
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions.
